• According to the 2011 census, **Goa's sex ratio is 973.**

• **Tamil Nadu's population increased from 62.4 million in 2001** to 72,147,039 at the time of the 2011 India Census. With a sex ratio of 996 females for every 1000 men, there were 36,137,975 males and 36,009,064 females. It had an** 80.09 per cent literacy rate.**
 
• **According to the 2011 census, Manipur's sex ratio is 985.** In Manipur, there were 974 females for** every 1000 males in 2001.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The gender ratio in India is 943 females for every 1000 males**, according to the 2011 Census. In urban areas, there are 929 females for every 1000 males, compared to **949 females for every 1000 males in rural areas.**
 
• **Males outnumber females in rural India **by 21,813,264 and in urban India by 13,872,275.
 
• In India, the term **"sex ratio" refers to the proportion of females to males** in a specific population. The greatest sex ratio in India is **1084 girls for every 1000 males in Kerala.**
